- You bring a strong technical understanding

- You are familiar with Debian Linux as well as modern technologies such as microservices, container technologies (Docker Swarm, Kubernetes), and cloud infrastructures

- Very good English skills (at least C1) enable smooth collaboration in international teams

jobs.occupation: Neuroscientist (m/w/d) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
We are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.
Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.
Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.
The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) - Experimental Cancer Neuroscience

München | As soon as possible | Full-/Part-time | Fixed-term (36 months)

The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural-tumor-immune interactions.

Depending on expertise, projects may include:

mechanistic studies of neuron-cancer and neuro-immune interactions
functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer
genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models
manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations
advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping
integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments
development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscience

A particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.

This may include:

preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments
planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments
establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models
management of genetically modified mouse colonies
breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning
coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories
implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfare
We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one - preferably several - of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular Biology

You should have:

a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline
substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models
strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments
excellent scientific communication skills in English
a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working style

Particularly desirable is extensive experience with:

animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications
genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management
tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniques

This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.
We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile.
Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a pr...

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for managing the cost-effective supply of materials & services in line with company processes based on customer requirements, while maintaining safety, quality and on-time delivery standards. Internally, you will provide an excellent customer orientated procurement service to support our Order Winning, Operations, Project Management, Engineering and Finance teams.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Drive cost savings and supplier performance in line with Grid Technology’s business goals
* Lead supplier negotiations and contract management, ensuring performance, compliance, safety and customer satisfaction
* Promote digitalization, AI-driven procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop strategic supplier relationships, implement supplier development programs and optimize supplier performance through scorecards and regular reviews
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, project management, legal, operations and order management, ensuring stakeholder alignment and transparency
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks, define BU-specific product strategies in line with Siemens Energy Guidelines and collaborate with commodity management to optimize market opportunities and purchasing volumes

What You Bring

* University degree in supply chain, business or a related field
* Long-term relevant professional experience in procurement with engineered products or service provision in a project environment; preferably in international sourcing
* Experience in service or project business and excellent understanding of contract law
* Advanced analytical, negotiation, stakeholder management and communication skills, with excellent English and ideally German language skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, SAP and analytical tools, with proven success in digital transformation initiatives
* Customer-focused, collaborative and self-motivated working style, with attention to detail, flexibility, prioritization, urgency, problem-solving, decision-making and continuous improvement skills

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* Neben einem attraktiven, marktgerechten Vergütungspaket erwartet Sie eine attraktive arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersversorgung
* Daneben bieten wir die Möglichkeit, zu sehr interessanten Mitarbeiterkonditionen Aktionär*in von Siemens Energy zu werden
* Unter unserem Motto #BetterTogether bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, flexibel und auch remote zu arbeiten. Aber auch unsere Büros lassen keine Wünsche offen und bieten Raum für inspirierende Zusammenarbeit und Kreativität
* Die berufliche und auch persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein großes Anliegen. Sie haben bei uns die Möglichkeit selbstbestimmt zu lernen und sich zu entwickeln. Dafür stehen unterschiedliche attraktive Programme und Maßnahmen zur Verfügung
* Unter dem Aspekt "Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf" haben wir ein vielfältiges Angebot, z.B. flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Kinderbetreuungsplätze an vielen Standorten, die Möglichkeit zur Schnupperteilzeit oder auch ein Sabbatical

jobs.description:
Job description

In order to support dynamics parts availability for H135 and H135 programs, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Dynamics parts Supply - H135 & H145 Responsible (d/f/m)

You will be part of the Customer Support organization, responsible for managing stock, backorders, and supplier performance, as well as ensuring the accuracy and availability of estimated delivery dates for elementary parts. This function directly supports dynamic spares and MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) activities for the H135 and H145 programs—an essential role in supporting the overhaul and repair of dynamic assemblies.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for the Dynamic Spares Supply team in Donauwörth and join the Rotor and Transmission Center of Excellence (CoE) community.

In this role, you will provide MRO workshops and Front Office teams with clear visibility into parts availability, enabling them to effectively plan their activities and optimize stock levels.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Oversee spare parts performance for Dynamics elementary components across the H135 and H145 programs.
- Act as the primary point of contact between Donauwörth, Airbus Helicopters Technik , Airbus Helicopters Inc. (AHI), Kawasaki, and external suppliers.
- Improve forecast accuracy and worldwide parts management to give suppliers clear visibility on S&OP capacity horizons and potential shortages.
- Provide MRO workshops and Front Office teams with clear visibility on parts availability to effectively plan their activities and optimize stock levels.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Supply Chain & Logistics Expertise: Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Engineering, with hands-on experience in stock management, inventory optimization, and backorder reduction (aerospace/MRO environment preferred).
- Supplier Management & S&OP: Proven track record in supplier performance management and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) to drive forecast accuracy, maintain accurate estimated delivery dates (EDDs), and anticipate shortage horizons.
- Cross-Functional & International Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to act as a seamless interface between multi-site teams (Donauwörth, Airbus Helicopters Technik, AHI, Kawasaki), external suppliers, and internal MRO/Front Office stakeholders.
- Analytical Tools & ERP Proficiency: Strong analytical background with solid experience using ERP systems (preferably SAP MM/PP) and data analytics tools for reporting, stock monitoring, and planning.
- Language Requirements: Business fluent in English (written and spoken); professional working proficiency in German is highly desirable given the local site environment and daily operational interfaces.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

jobs.occupation: People Operations Specialist (m/f/d) (Assistent/in - Personalwesen)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who thrive on ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

Scaling this mission takes a People function that's just as rigorous, clear and compliant, precision isn't optional it is the standard and this extends to how we build and support our team. As People Operations Specialist, you'll be a hands-on part of that foundation, owning first-tier employee support while growing into broader People Operations responsibilities.

Your roadmap to make an impact

- Employee support & documentation: Be the first point of contact for employee inquiries and own HR-related documentation, including Arbeitsbescheinigungen, EZB, Zeugnisse, and other employee documents.
- Benefits & HR administration: Handle employee questions around benefits and support the day-to-day administration of benefits and other HR processes.
- Employment contracts: Support employment contract processes, including preparing new contracts, amendments, and related documentation.
- Payroll: Support payroll-related processes and data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely execution.
- Keep employee data accurate and up to date: Maintain personnel master data and documentation with a high level of precision and confidentiality.
- Take on different responsibilities: Get involved across HR Operations and take ownership of new topics as they arise, constantly getting involved in different areas, figuring things out, and getting things done.
- Learn and grow: Build experience across the employee lifecycle and take on increasing responsibility as you develop.

Job requirements

- 1–2 years of experience in HR, People Operations, or a similar role.
- Ownership & initiative: You take responsibility, follow things through, and proactively solve problems rather than waiting to be told what to do.
- Fast learner & hands-on mindset: You pick up new topics quickly, enjoy figuring things out, and are happy to jump into different areas and take on new responsibilities.
- Reliable & detail-oriented: You’re highly organized and precise, especially when working with employee data, contracts, payroll, and other sensitive information.
- Strong communication skills: You’re approachable, responsive, and comfortable working in a fast paced international environment
- Fluent German and strong English, both written and spoken are required.

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.
